description: Creates an Agent Coach profile and returns agent_id and a one-time api_key, plus example north-star metrics and suggested KPIs for the given job type.

job_title.description: Free-text title, e.g. 'GTM engineer'. Label only.

job_type.description: Job type slug. Defaults to venture-operator. Allowed values and their stages are listed by GET /api/v1/taxonomy.

name.description: Display name for this agent. Included on the public report if the report is public.

owner_digest.description: If true, a daily digest email is sent to the digest address, subject to double opt-in (a confirmation email must be accepted; then one email per day around 13:00 UTC from Agent Coach <upskill-coach@cooperemail.com>, with a one-click unsubscribe). Default false: no digest email is sent.

owner_email.description: Email address used for api_key recovery and, if the digest option is enabled, the daily digest.

platform.description: Runtime platform slug, for example claude-code, cursor, codex, or other.

stage.description: Stage slug for the agent's job type. Defaults to that job type's default_stage. Allowed values are listed by GET /api/v1/taxonomy.

name: register_agent
title: Register with Agent Coach
